slides.title: The Generative AI Landscape
content: Generative AI: a family of specialized models
Each with a unique creative skill
Exploring different types and their real-world uses
narration: Welcome!
Generative AI isn't just one single technology.
It's a whole family of specialized models, each with a unique creative skill.
This module explores different generative models.
It also covers the amazing things they can do in the real world.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration of a diverse group of AI robots, each holding a tool representing a different creative skill (e.g., pen for text, paintbrush for image, music note for audio, keyboard for code).

slides.title: Learning Objectives
content: Identify the three primary categories of generative AI models
Recognize common applications for text, image, and audio generation
Apply critical thinking to generative AI outputs, especially regarding "hallucinations"
narration: In this tutorial, you will identify primary generative AI categories.
You will also recognize their common applications.
Finally, you will apply critical thinking to AI outputs.
This is especially true regarding 'hallucinations'.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration of a person with a thoughtful expression, surrounded by floating icons representing different learning concepts like a lightbulb, a checklist, and a magnifying glass.

slides.title: Prerequisites
content: Basic understanding of what Artificial Intelligence is
Familiarity with using a web browser and text input
narration: You need a basic understanding of Artificial Intelligence.
You should also be familiar with using a web browser and text input.
No coding or advanced technical skills are needed.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration of a simple brain icon connected to a computer mouse and keyboard, showing basic understanding and interaction.

slides.title: What is Generative AI?
content: Not one technology, but a family of specialized models
Each model has a unique creative skill
Transforms how we create, communicate, and solve problems
narration: Generative AI transforms how we create, communicate, and solve problems.
Understanding its forms helps you leverage these tools effectively and responsibly.
Let's explore these capabilities.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration showing a dynamic flow of creative energy transforming from a generic AI icon into various forms: text, images, music, and code. Dynamic and vibrant colors.

slides.title: Text Generation: Your AI Wordsmith
content: Most common type of Generative AI
Powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) like Gemini and GPT
Trained on vast text data, generates human language fluently
narration: Let's begin with Text Generation.
This is the most common type of generative AI.
It's powered by Large Language Models, or LLMs, like Gemini and GPT.
These models are trained on extensive datasets of text.
This allows them to understand human language.
They also generate it with incredible fluency.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration of a person at a laptop, with words and sentences creatively flowing from the screen like a river. A quill pen or a speech bubble can be seen, symbolizing language.

slides.title: How Text AI Works & Uses
content: LLMs predict the next most likely word in a sequence
Applications: Summarization, Translation, Chatbots, Content Creation, Sentiment Analysis
narration: LLMs analyze patterns in massive text datasets.
They predict the next most likely word.
This allows them to generate coherent, human-like text.
They are used for summarization and translation.
They also power chatbots, content creation, and sentiment analysis.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration of a friendly AI robot assistant performing multiple tasks: summarizing a document, translating text between languages, chatting with a user, and generating creative text, all simultaneously.

slides.title: Warning: AI "Hallucinations"
content: LLMs sometimes state incorrect but plausible information
This is called a 'hallucination'
It's a byproduct of prediction, not a bug
narration: Sometimes, an LLM states something incorrect.
However, it sounds completely plausible and confident.
This is called a hallucination.
It's not a bug.
Instead, it's a byproduct of how the AI predicts the next most likely word.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration of a chef in a kitchen confidently presenting a dish that is clearly imaginary or made up of impossible ingredients, while a customer looks confused. The chef has a big, proud smile.

slides.title: Golden Rule: Fact-Check!
content: Analogy: Overly eager chef making up dishes
Golden Rule: Always fact-check critical information
Example: Incorrectly stating the discoverer of relativity
narration: Imagine an overly eager chef.
When they don't know an ingredient, they make one up on the spot.
They do this to be helpful.
That's what an AI hallucination is.
The golden rule is: Always fact-check any critical information an LLM gives you!
For example, an AI might incorrectly tell you who discovered relativity.
This happened in 1900.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration of a person holding a magnifying glass, scrutinizing a piece of paper with text from an AI, while the AI chatbot looks on innocently. A red 'X' or 'fact check' stamp is visible.

slides.title: Image & Video Generation: The Artists
content: Models create brand-new visuals from text descriptions (prompts)
Powerful tools for creativity, design, and visualization
narration: Next, let's explore Image and Video Generation.
These models create brand-new, stunning visuals.
They do this from a simple text description, also known as a prompt.
They are powerful tools for creativity, design, and visualization.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration of a painter's easel, but instead of brushes, an AI robot's arm is conjuring a vibrant image from glowing text floating in the air. The image on the easel is complex and beautiful.

slides.title: Diffusion Models Explained
content: Most popular technique: Diffusion Model
Starts with random pixels (noise)
Uses text prompt as a guide
Refines noise step-by-step until a clear image emerges
narration: The most popular technique is called a diffusion model.
It works in a fascinating way.
It starts with a canvas full of random pixels, like television static or noise.
It then uses your text prompt as a guide.
Step by step, it refines the noise until a clear and detailed image emerges.
It's like a sculptor starting with a messy block of clay.
They gradually shape it until the final statue, your desired image, appears.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration of a sculptor in a studio. The first panel shows them starting with a shapeless, noisy block of clay. The second panel shows them progressively refining the clay, guided by a floating text prompt, until the third panel shows a detailed, beautiful statue.

slides.title: Applications of Visual AI
content: Art & Creativity: Creating original artwork in any style
Advertising: Generating unique product photos or marketing visuals
Product Design: Visualizing concepts for new items
Entertainment: Concept art for movies, characters for games
narration: These powerful visual AI tools have many uses.
Anyone can create beautiful, original artwork in any style imaginable.
They help in advertising.
They generate unique product photos without a physical photoshoot.
They assist in product design by quickly visualizing new concepts.
And in entertainment, they create concept art for movies.
They also create characters for video games.
slides.image_prompt: Montage of four cartoon vignettes: 1) a person creating a fantastical painting, 2) a product ad with a perfectly generated item, 3) a designer sketching a new shoe concept, 4) a movie character concept art.

slides.title: Code Generation: The Developer's Assistant
content: AI models trained on billions of lines of public code
Act as an incredibly smart assistant for programmers
Automates tasks, suggests code, helps find bugs
narration: Beyond text and images, generative AI masters other complex domains.
One example is code generation.
Tools like GitHub Copilot are AI models.
They are trained on billions of lines of public code.
They don't replace human programmers; they act as an incredibly smart assistant.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration of a busy software developer at their computer, looking happy and productive. Next to them, a helpful AI robot assistant is holding up relevant code snippets or tools, making the developer's work easier.

slides.title: How Code AI Helps Developers
content: Suggests next lines of code as you type
Translates comments into functional code
Helps find and fix bugs, boosting efficiency
narration: How does it help?
It can suggest the next few lines of code as you type.
It translates comments into functional code.
And it helps find bugs.
This makes developers faster and more efficient.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration showing a developer's screen. On one side, the developer types a comment. On the other side, the AI assistant instantly generates corresponding code. A small magnifying glass icon highlights a detected bug, which the AI then fixes.

slides.title: Audio Generation: Crafting Sound
content: Models trained on sounds, voices, and music
Creates realistic human voices, original music, sound effects
Opens new possibilities for content creation and accessibility
narration: Now, let's look at Audio Generation: the art of crafting sound.
These models are trained on sounds, voices, and music.
Audio generation AI creates realistic human voices.
It can compose original music.
It also generates various sound effects.
This opens new possibilities for content creation and accessibility.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration of a sound engineer or music producer in a studio, surrounded by mixing boards, microphones, and headphones. Sound waves and musical notes are playfully floating around, originating from an AI interface.

slides.title: Applications of Audio AI
content: Voice Synthesis & Text-to-Speech: Realistic human voices for audiobooks, assistants
Music Creation: Composing royalty-free background music, new melodies, or songs in specific styles
narration: What can they do?
They perform voice synthesis and text-to-speech.
This creates realistic human-like voices for audiobooks or virtual assistants.
They also help with music creation.
They can compose royalty-free background music.
They also generate new melodies or songs in the style of a famous artist.
slides.image_prompt: Montage of three cartoon vignettes: 1) a person listening to an audiobook with a natural-sounding voice, 2) a video playing with calming background music, 3) a DJ robot mixing unique music tracks.

slides.title: Summary
content: Generative AI includes Text, Image/Video, Code, and Audio models
Text AI uses LLMs for tasks like summarization and content creation
Image/Video AI (Diffusion Models) creates visuals from prompts
Code AI assists developers with suggestions and bug fixing
Audio AI generates realistic voices and original music
Always fact-check AI outputs due to 'hallucinations'
narration: Let's quickly summarize what we learned today.
Generative AI includes models for text, image and video, code, and audio.
Text AI uses LLMs for tasks like summarization.
Image and Video AI uses Diffusion Models to create visuals.
Code AI assists developers, and Audio AI generates voices and music.
Remember to always fact-check AI outputs due to 'hallucinations'.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration of a large, friendly AI brain icon with four smaller icons around it representing text (a book), image (a camera), code (brackets), and audio (a music note), all interconnected by glowing lines.

slides.title: Your Turn! Practical Exercises
content: Task 1: Text Generation - Summarize and Expand an email
Task 2: Image Generation - Describe a detailed image vision
Task 3: Application Reflection - Identify how AI could assist a routine task
narration: Now, let's put your understanding of generative AI into practice.
Think through these prompts to understand their capabilities.
First, for text generation, summarize an email and then expand on a key point.
Second, describe a detailed image you'd like an AI to create.
Third, reflect on a routine task.
Consider how generative AI could assist you.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration of a person sitting at a desk, looking thoughtful and engaged. Around them are thought bubbles containing icons related to text (a paragraph), images (a landscape), and a checklist, symbolizing practical tasks.
